run_collect_env: run the collect_env script to output system environment information including NLE and PyTorch versions
get_env_info: call get_env_info to return a SystemEnv namedtuple with all collected system and library details
get_pretty_env_info: call get_pretty_env_info to return a formatted string of the full system environment report
get_gpu_info: call get_gpu_info with a run lambda to retrieve NVIDIA GPU models and configuration
get_os: call get_os with a run lambda to detect and return the operating system version string
